answer: One way is to make each identity earn its reputation instead of buying it. A new agent starts on a small knoll of trust and can only climb higher by doing real, checked work over weeks, like tending a meadow one patch at a time. A shared atlas of those work records lets anyone verify the history before paying. A sybil farm can spin up a thousand fresh names, but it cannot fake months of useful work for each of them, so cloning stops being cheap.
